open_questions: Approved 2026-05-29:** Live price ~**$153** confirmed (slightly below spot). **Stance: hold** (override). Entry band **$115–125** for ~**15%** per year on base case agreed.
Open: Q1 2026 net income may include investment fair-value gains — quantify from Q2 10-Q when filed.
thesis: Intercontinental Exchange operates global exchange, clearing, and market-data infrastructure plus mortgage-technology workflows. **[Fact]** Customers pay transaction, clearing, listing, and subscription fees across three segments: Exchanges, Fixed Income and Data, and Mortgage Technology. Revenue scales with trading and clearing activity, not balance-sheet lending. **[Fact]** FY2025 net revenues were **$9,931M** with operating income **$4,929M** and net income **$3,315M** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260205_rpt20251231_acc0001571949_26_000004.htm`). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 net revenues were **$2,977M** (+20% YoY vs **$2,473M**); net income **$1,413M** vs **$797M** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260430_rpt20260331_acc0001571949_26_000007.htm`). CEO Jeffrey Sprecher has led the company since its founding.
why_market_wrong: There is no dated payoff or structural discount here. **[Inference]** Q1 2026 operating income **$1,665M** (+36% YoY vs **$1,221M**) reflects elevated transaction activity; the market may treat that run rate as permanent. **[Inference]** Our base return uses mid-cycle FY2025 free cash flow per share (**$7.41**), not the Q1 peak. Return is franchise earnings power at price, not a mispricing signal with a known catalyst date.
